title: SaasKiller setup.sh configuration spec
description: Machine-readable contract for pre-answering setup.sh questions via a config file. Another agent (or a human) writes a setup.config.ini against this spec; `./setup.sh <project> --config <file>` reads it, skips answered questions, and interactively prompts only for what is missing. See SETUP_CONFIG.md for the full guide.

config_format.notes: Flat key=value pairs. Keys are case-insensitive. Section headers [like-this] are cosmetic and ignored by the parser. Whole-line comments start with # or ;. Inline comments are supported: a space followed by # or ; to end of line is stripped (so 'key = value  # note' works, while a '#' with no preceding space is kept as part of the value). Booleans accept: true/false, yes/no, y/n, 1/0. Any key omitted falls back to interactive prompt (default behaviour) unless --non-interactive is passed, in which case the documented default is used and required keys without a value abort.

keys.prompt: Project name (lowercase, no spaces, e.g. myapp)
keys.note: Usually passed as the first CLI arg (./setup.sh myapp). If given there, the config value is ignored. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphen, underscore only.
Multi-tenant workspaces/teams. Strips backend/workspaces + workspace routes/stores if false.

keys.prompt: CMS — pages, blog, structured content (feincms3, server-rendered, crawlable)?
keys.note: feincms3 CMS with server-rendered Svelte islands. Strips backend/content + frontend/src/islands if false.
Stripe billing. Strips backend/billing + billing routes/store/api if false.
django-q2 async task queue + worker. Strips backend/tasks if false.
django-channels realtime. Strips backend/realtime + websocket util/notifications store if false.
File uploads via nine.ch S3 object storage. Strips backend/storage if false. NOTE: default backend is cloud S3 — reconfigure to local FS if local-first is required.
Paraglide i18n (de/en). When false, all m.*() calls must be avoided and layout uses plain render. Strips frontend/project.inlang + messages if false.
Sentry error monitoring. Needs network; skip for LAN-only services.
Programmatic API key management. Strips backend/apikeys + api-keys route/store/api if false.
GitHub OAuth as a second login provider (magic-link is always present).
Capacitor mobile wrapper. Strips capacitor.config.ts + build-mobile.sh + cap:build script if false.
Feedloop feedback widget (screen recording, AI triage, GitHub Issues). Requires ~/coding/feedloop present locally to copy from.
deploio = nine.ch Swiss PaaS (nctl CLI). pythonanywhere = PythonAnywhere. none = local only, no deploy files.
Create a staging environment. Ignored when hosting=none.
Create a production environment. If neither staging nor production is chosen, hosting falls back to none.
GitHub org/user that owns the repo — used to generate deploy-init.sh.
Repo name; defaults to project_name if left empty.

keys.prompt: Production domain (e.g. myapp.ch, leave empty to skip)
keys.note: Custom production domain. Empty = skip custom domain.
PythonAnywhere account username.
The webapp domain on PythonAnywhere.
Absolute path of the app dir on the PA server, e.g. /home/<user>/<project>.
